text:
Avery (People Ops): Quick heads-up: All-hands scheduled Tue 10am PT (HQ + Zoom). Please read agenda below and toss Qs in-thread or via the short form: https://forms.redwood.internal/allhands-qna (anon option).

Avery (People Ops): Proposed agenda (25m):
• 8m — Exec snapshot: runway, hiring cadence, key metrics (Zoe)
• 6m — Product launch playbook & success criteria (Priya)
• 4m — Runtime perf wins + rollout plan (Yamir)
• 3m — Security update: retention policy tweak & impact (Marcus)
• 2m — GTM highlight: partner launch mention (Lena)
• 2m — Rapid-fire Q&A (may extend by a few mins)

Avery (People Ops): Logistics: please upload any demo slides to drive.redwood.internal/allhands/tues-2026 by Mon 5pm. If you need live demo resources (GPU, test tenant), list them here.

Zoe (CEO): I'll kick off with a quick note on business health and one ask: leaders, please be ready to share one risk and one milestone.

Priya (Product): We'll present the playbook + a short checklist for launches (integration owners, CS handoff, docs). Requesting a 2-slide spot. Will add the playbook link in chat during the call: https://confluence.redwood.internal/playbooks/launch-2026

Yamir (Eng): Heads-up: we'll demo the KV-prefetch improvement (shows ~12% p99 improvement in internal benchmarks). Low-risk; needs screen share + short recording embedded.

Marcus (Security): Retention policy update: we're proposing reducing default logs retention from 90d to 45d for internal debug logs to cut storage cost. This does not change customer-facing retention defaults. I'll summarize scope and timeline in my 3-minute slot.

Lena (Sales): Quick note: we'll mention partner integration in GTM highlight. Also request RevOps prepare a one-pager for CSMs re: pricing bundle adjustments mentioned last week.

Avery (People Ops): Reminder: if your update involves customer-sensitive data, mark slides as restricted and send to me directly. We'll include recording captions and post the clip to #all-hands-recordings after the meeting.

Priya (Product): Suggestion: add a 30s customer story snippet after product to show immediate value. Anyone with a short quote, drop it here.

Lena (Sales): I'll paste a short quote from Beta customer X.

Yamir (Eng): Can Eng get the meeting link in the calendar invite with presenter perms? Demos need screen share access.

Calendar Bot: Event updated: "All-Hands 11 Playbook & Launch" Tue 10:00 PT 11 Zoom link pinned to calendar.

Avery (People Ops): We'll record and post within 24 hours. If you want specific timestamps clipped for your team, DM me the range and I'll surface them in the follow-up.

Marcus (Security): Question: will the retention change apply to Dedicated customers who opt into longer retention?

Priya (Product): Short answer: no change to Dedicated customer defaults without an explicit opt-in. Marcus will confirm during his slot.

Avery (People Ops): Final ask: please keep updates tight (1-2 slides, 90s max) so we can run Q&A. Drop your slide-ready confirmation below once uploaded. :calendar:
